primary_source_used.title: On sharp bounds for marginal densities of product measures
primary_source_used.scope: cap-one product laws; k-dimensional orthogonal marginal cap <=2^(k/2); no moments/iid/smoothness/log-concavity

new_results.statement: For Q=2(X0+ell.X)(g.X)+d(beta.X)^2, if on an original-coordinate subset J the local Gram area Omega_J>0 and ell_J lies in span{g_J,beta_J}, then dens(Q)<=3*4^(2/3)(|d|Omega_J)^(-1/3), with no restrictions on active coefficients on the conditioned complement.
For any two leaves i,j with det A[{0,i,j}] nonzero, dens(Q)<=3*2^(2/3)|det A[{0,i,j}]|^(-1/3); arbitrary source-entangled twist is allowed.
In the target-normalized heavy exact-null packet, sum_{j!=i}|det A[{0,i,j}]|=hDq_i>1/10. If one term is >=1/320 then dens(Q)<=32.5730113991. Otherwise at least 33 anchored leaves are nonzero.

unresolved_implication: High-cardinality diffuse anchored-volume star in the punctured nonzero-tiny-edge, source-entangled collar: q_i>1/2, 0<|g_i|<1/64, every anchored 3x3 determinant <1/320, total anchored determinant mass >1/10, plus failure of existing diffuse/source-separated exits.
